title: The homotopy unit pastes with a single cartesian refinement
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, f:X→Y a morphism of schemes, c,d compactifications, and r:c→d a refinement with cartesian square over X [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Let F be an additive exact functor from small-etale A-module sheaves on X to those on Y [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and a:F→(d.i)!⋙(d.g)* any natural transformation. Let t_r be the explicitly constructed sheaf refinement map [lem-sfb-compactification-sheaf-refinement]. Write N(F,O,P,a) for normalizationHomotopyTransformation [def-asd-compact-support-graph-comparison], the exact-source factorization, followed by Qh(a), followed by the right-derived unit of P and the inverse exact factorization of O. Then N(F,(d.i)!,(d.g)*,a), followed by Qh-whiskering of the canonical derived refinement comparison [def-amb-etale-compact-support], equals N(F,(c.i)!,(c.g)*,a;t_r). No finite-coefficient, Noetherian, or invertibility assumption on a is needed.

proof.text: On a homotopy representative, use the derived-adjunction unit factorization for the exact inverse-image functor. Apply the exact derived triangle comparison to inverse open base change. Its inverse formula follows by canceling only the exact comparison isomorphisms. Naturality of the right-derived unit gives the unit for the adjunct of inverse open base change.

Apply the right-derived composition-unit identity. It combines the refinement direct-image unit and the coarser proper direct-image unit into the finer direct-image unit, with the ordinary direct-image compositor. This identity is rightDerivedNatTrans_app applied to rightDerivedFunctorCompIso and rightDerivedFunctorNatIso; direct image preserves K-injectives because its left adjoint is exact.

Move the supplied natural transformation a through the units by naturality. The ordinary factors are exactly a;t_r and the exact comparison factors are precisely those in N. Associativity therefore gives the claimed equality as natural transformations on the homotopy category.

theorem compactificationRefinement_homotopyUnit
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} {c d : Compactification f}
    (r : c.Refinement d) (hcart : IsPullback c.i (𝟙 X) r.hom d.i)
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) ⥤
      Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))
    [F.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    (a : F ⟶ openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) d.i ⋙
      lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) d.g) :
    normalizationHomotopyTransformation F
        (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) d.i)
        (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) d.g) a ≫
      Functor.whiskerLeft DerivedCategory.Qh
        (rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationComparison (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) r hcart) =
    normalizationHomotopyTransformation F
      (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.i)
      (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g)
      (a ≫ compactificationSheafRefinement A r hcart)
